body:
Finite Event replay and Scope, Bead and Link SSE admission now handle lexically valid opaque minimum positions through the existing bounded waiter. Eligible current observations return contextual epoch/view refusals or catch-up-timeout when the minimum remains unproved. This includes retained Event cursors and SSE reconnect admission, with minimum checks before retained Event selection and HTTP shortcuts.

The six-file change builds directly on PR166. It preserves default strict owner/service calls, the previous initial-Scope-SSE intent, cursor/receiving checks, immutable capture across retries and the subsequent stream pump. Minimum-before-cursor composition is a reviewed implementation choice under the general remaining-read rule. Public discovery/profile admission, changefeed composition, S1/G2 and fresh cumulative profile qualification remain unfinished.

Validation: native and actual Claude CODE review completed with explicit findings dispositions. An exact five-file formatting correction passed independent syntax/preservation review. All19 fresh local validation stages passed, with only the original install/tool-binding prerequisites separately reused. The selected source run passed17 callbacks with60 unselected skips and12new/4legacy reports. Fresh archives were installed into an isolated consumer with870files/17links/eight production versions verified. Separately supervised historical5-request and new10-request callbacks and their immediate audits passed against the same installed payload. Historical evidence has two clean child exits and narrower lifecycle fields; the new witness observes one child exit/close, a live complete Event frame followed by drain, no pending operations and store removal.

Boundaries, seven preflight tests, package smoke and historical Read verification passed. Native final audit independently verified all source/build/archive/consumer records and found all401 sampled fresh-stage PIDs and41 original bootstrap PIDs absent. The89-row Read seal retains its historical run identity; it is not fresh write-profile evidence. Exact-head push CI39082528652 passed all27 steps:9464 tests across186 files, one optional skip, plus7 preflight checks. The intact CI reports include12 new source observations and separate historical5/new10 process exchanges. Eight unrelated masked observations remain unparsed. CI ran workspace-dist development-local payload495fa1d4; local external-consumer payloadda80f6d7 remains separate. Lint passed with121warnings and6informational diagnostics. Original formatting failure and the historical-auditor failure are preserved: the historical report has resolved entry/hash/payload evidence but lacks the newer entryLiteral diagnostic; the corrected auditor keeps that literal requirement mandatory for the new witness.

Local external-consumer proof is distinct from CI workspace-dist execution. Source-derived request totals are not an independently reconstructed wire census. This establishes a bounded private serving increment, not full-profile qualification or release readiness.

Evidence and remaining delivery inventory: [sole implementation plan](https://github.com/donnabox/beads/blob/codex/vickie-bdp-client-design/docs/architecture/bdp-client-v2/design.md).
